home.heroSubtitle: A SkyLine concealed door sits in the same plane as the wall. Not furniture — part of the architecture.
home.aboutLead: Concealed installation removes the visible frame, architraves and hinges. An aluminium frame disappears into the wall; the leaf sits flush and can be painted the same colour.
home.aboutText: This solution is especially useful when you need:
home.aboutFeature1: Wall and leaf share one plane
home.aboutFeature2: The frame is hidden in the construction
home.aboutFeature3: Hinges are invisible from the front
home.aboutFeature4: The gap reads as a joint, not a frame
home.benefitsLead: Concealed installation makes the door part of the architecture, not a separate furniture piece.
home.benefit1: Leaf flush with the wall — without an extra “frame”
home.benefit2: Aluminium frame for plaster or drywall
home.benefit3: Hidden hinges and precise opening geometry
home.benefit5: Suitable for residential and commercial projects
home.howLead: The frame goes in during rough works. After wall finishing, the leaf is hung and the gap geometry is set.
home.how1: Hidden Frame — the frame disappears into the wall
home.how2: Invisible Hinges — hinges sit in the leaf thickness
home.how3: Flush Leaf — the leaf aligns with the wall plane
home.how4: Final Finish — finishing together with the wall
home.typesLead: The choice follows the finish: paint-ready, ready décor, or glass in a concealed frame.
home.typesPaintReadyDesc: Primed leaf flush with the wall. After finishing, the door reads as part of the plaster.
home.typesFinishedDesc: Enamel, wood décors, concrete and other finishes — without architraves or a visible frame.
home.typesGlassDesc: Glass inserts while keeping concealed installation and a clean plane.
home.ctaText: A drawing, a wall photo, or simply the brief. We size the system to the architecture — not the other way around.

about.title: About the studio.
about.welcome: SkyLine makes concealed doors part of the architecture. Full-cycle production control — from material to finished leaf.
about.missionText: We focus on clarity and quality of execution.
about.mission1: We explain how concealed doors differ from standard doors
about.mission2: We help choose the leaf: paint-ready, finished or with glass
about.mission3: We advise when to install the frame
about.why1Text: We work with flush-to-wall systems. We understand frames, hinges and finishes.
about.why2Text: Help choosing paint-ready or finished options. Guidance on the opening.
about.why3Text: Modern equipment, European supplier materials, control during assembly.
about.productionText: Quality control at every stage: preparing parts, machining, assembly, inspection and packaging.
about.philosophyText: When the door nearly disappears, the space feels calmer and more refined.
about.philosophy2: More attention to plane, light and material
about.philosophy3: Correct installation as the base of the result
about.contactText: Renovation or design project — we will match a system to your interior.
about.contactEnd: SkyLine helps compare options and choose a solution.

gallery.title: Surface and opening.
gallery.lead: Leaves, finishes, glass and production — examples of plane, not a furniture catalogue.

doorsPaintReady.title: Paint-ready.
doorsPaintReady.caption: Primer · wall · one plane
doorsPaintReady.lead: A primed leaf for filling and painting — the door reads as part of the wall.
doorsPaintReady.text1: The core concealed option: after finishing, the leaf is painted the same colour as the wall. Aluminium frame and hidden hinges stay inside the construction.
doorsPaintReady.text2: An aluminium edge — grey or black — can read as a precise architectural joint. Opening: standard or reverse.
doorsPaintReady.feature1: Primed surface ready for the room finish
doorsPaintReady.feature3: Hidden hinges and an even gap
doorsPaintReady.text3: The frame goes in before final finishes — otherwise matching the wall and door plane is harder.
doorsPaintReady.end: An “invisible door” effect on painted walls and decorative plaster.
doorsPaintReady.specsLead: Leaf, concealed frame, edge and hardware are sized to the opening and renovation stage.
doorsPaintReady.ctaText: We will advise how to install a paint-ready system at your renovation stage.

doorsFinished.title: Finished.
doorsFinished.caption: Enamel · wood · concrete
doorsFinished.lead: A ready leaf finish with a concealed aluminium frame — no architraves or visible frame.
doorsFinished.text1: When you need an expressive surface: enamel, wood décors, concrete and other coatings. The door stays flush with the wall.
doorsFinished.text2: Tone-on-tone with the wall or contrast. ABS edge matching the leaf, or an aluminium edge as an accent.
doorsFinished.feature2: Finishes: enamel, wood, concrete and more
doorsFinished.text3: A stable look and predictable result without wet work on the leaf.
doorsFinished.where2: Projects with a ready wall surface
doorsFinished.end: Concealed installation plus freedom in leaf material.
doorsFinished.specsTitle: Material as part of the wall.
doorsFinished.specsLead: The finish sets the character of the opening — from calm supermatt to a clear wood décor.
doorsFinished.ctaText: We will match a finish to wall materials and opening direction.

doorsGlass.title: With glass.
doorsGlass.caption: Light · privacy · plane
doorsGlass.lead: Glass or mirror with concealed installation: light between zones, door flush with the wall.
doorsGlass.text1: Inserts add lightness without a classic framed door. Concealed frame and hinges keep clean geometry.
doorsGlass.text2: Clear, frosted, tinted glass or mirror — by privacy and light brief.
doorsGlass.feature1: Glass or mirror in the leaf
doorsGlass.text3: Works well in offices, corridors and open-plan layouts.
doorsGlass.end: Privacy with a lighter geometry of space.
doorsGlass.specsTitle: Glass as part of the plane.
doorsGlass.specsLead: Different inserts and edges — from calm frosted glass to mirror.
doorsGlass.ctaText: We will suggest glass type and opening side for your scenario.

installation.title: From opening to plane.
installation.caption: Frame · hinges · leaf
installation.lead: Concealed installation starts during rough works — before final wall painting.
installation.text1: The aluminium frame is set so that after plaster or drywall the leaf sits flush with the wall.
installation.text2: Hidden hinges and adjustment set the gap. Standard or reverse opening, magnetic lock and edge options are available.
installation.step1Text: Sizes, wall thickness and frame feasibility.
installation.step2Text: Aluminium frame in the opening with geometry control.
installation.step3Text: Plaster or drywall to the frame plane, then final finish.
installation.note1: The frame goes in before final finishes
installation.note2: Wall thickness must match the system
installation.note4: Opening side and edge are set in the specification
installation.end: If renovation is already finishing — write to us: we will advise what remains possible.
installation.ctaText: A drawing or opening photo — we will say when to install the system.
